releaseNotes:
• Automatic Landscape Window Adaptation: All popup browsers, web apps, and mini-tools automatically open in 16:9 widescreen format whenever the device or underlying app/game is in landscape mode
• Seamless Widescreen Viewport: Proportional 16:9 aspect ratio centered comfortably on horizontal displays without narrow portrait letterboxing
• Retains 1-tap manual 🔄 ratio toggle in window header bar for on-demand portrait switching
